project.name: nablatensor-opencl
project.description: OpenCL replay engine: the recorded tape becomes a fused forward+adjoint OpenCL C kernel, built once with clBuildProgram and replayed one scenario per work-item. Shares the CUDA engine's code generator, lightly rewritten to OpenCL C, so any conformant OpenCL 1.2+ device with cl_khr_fp64 can run it.
